title: Stable influence of leading-coordinate majority
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. The stable influence at parameter $1-\delta$ of the leading coordinate of the real-valued function obtained by multiplying odd majority on $2m+1$ signs by a new leading coordinate is at least $1-\sqrt{\delta}$.
